native stage synchronization. Post-Initialize observer runs after all parallel
ProblemGenerator calls and native initialization; no last-block race assumption.

recorded native coordinate rounding, stage/end target tracking, native integrated
face divergence, source-inclusive mass/E ledgers and internal flux cancellation,
actual upstream fast Mach/work, strict pre-floor aborts and default1block behavior.
Manufactured/real24-cell gates use rmax1AU because uniform24 over0.1..2.3 places
inner ghost centers at negative radius.48/96 gates use production radial bounds.
All gates remain short,<=60s wall,<=1GB resident/AS guard,<=4threads,nice15. No full
campaign is authorized from this derivative until gates and measured costs pass.
